name: NGC 7173 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7173, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc7173-hubble
story: A smooth elliptical galaxy in Hickson Compact Group 90, a tight knot of galaxies where a neighboring spiral is being pulled apart. Hubble surveyed its globular clusters to compare ellipticals outside rich clusters with those inside them.

claims.text: NGC 7173 is a smooth, normal elliptical galaxy in Hickson Compact Group 90
Its neighbor NGC 7174 is a spiral being pulled apart
Program 10554 studied the globular cluster populations of ellipticals in low-density environments to compare with rich-cluster samples; NGC7173 is a target
